tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.wall_redston: Sticks to walls and ceilings and runs round outside corners. Loses 1 strength per block, like dust.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.dish_rotator: A mast segment that turns the Dish Antenna on top: redstone 0 points it the way its arrow does, each step 22.5° clockwise.
Place it in the tower's mast column, or right-click the tower with it to put it in under the top; its arrow (the way you look) is where 0 points. Its redstone doesn't go up to the tower.
message.reikos_signal_tower.rotator_adde: Dish Rotator added under the %1$s (%2$s masts up, reach %3$s → %4$s blocks); redstone 0 points its dish %5$s
message.reikos_signal_tower.rotator_grow: Dish Rotator added on top of the masts: %s tall
message.reikos_signal_tower.dish_rotated: The Dish Rotator in its mast turns this %1$s's dish (it points %2$s now)
jade.reikos_signal_tower.rotator_no_dish: No Dish Antenna on top to turn
jade.reikos_signal_tower.rotator_overrul: A Dish Rotator higher up turns the dish instead
Carries all 16 colors at once, each 0-15, with no loss along the way. Cable Taps put redstone onto a color and take it off again; a Bundled Radio Transmitter sends the whole cable over the radio.
block.reikos_signal_tower.cable_tap.tool: Put it against a Bundled Cable. In (the default): the redstone it gets goes onto its color. Out: it gives its color out as redstone. Right-click to switch; dye it to pick the color.
block.reikos_signal_tower.bundled_transm: Sends a whole Bundled Cable: tuned to F, white goes out on F, orange on F+1 ... black on F+15. Feed it with a cable beside it or beside any mast of its tower.
block.reikos_signal_tower.bundled_receiv: Hears the 16 frequencies from its own on (F white ... F+15 black) and puts them on the Bundled Cables touching it.
block.reikos_signal_tower.guy_anchor.too: Put it on the ground 2 to 12 blocks from a tower: a steel wire runs to its mast. Three on one mast brace the tower, so tornadoes, hurricanes and derechos (Reiko's Weather) can't blow it down.
block.reikos_signal_tower.tower_platform: Right-click a mast with these and they go in all round it at that height, with rails. You come up through it climbing the mast; sneak beside the mast to go back down.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.mast_climb: Walk into a mast to climb it; let go to slide down, sneak to hold still.
jade.reikos_signal_tower.found_tower: An old radio tower, found in the world
jade.reikos_signal_tower.raid_coming: Raid! The pillagers are on their way
message.reikos_signal_tower.raid_start: RAID! Pillagers are coming to the village
message.reikos_signal_tower.raid_victory: The raid is over: the village held
message.reikos_signal_tower.raid_loss: The raid is over: the village fell
advancements.reikos_signal_tower.first_b: Put a Radio Transmitter on the air
advancements.reikos_signal_tower.over_th: Put a transmitter on the air that reaches 500 blocks or more
advancements.reikos_signal_tower.head_fo: Climb a mast and stand on a Tower Platform
advancements.reikos_signal_tower.weather: Watch a tall tower braced with guy wires stand through a tornado, hurricane or derecho
advancements.reikos_signal_tower.lost_si: Find an old radio tower out in the world
advancements.reikos_signal_tower.finders: Bring an old radio tower back on the air
message.reikos_signal_tower.bundled_tx_s: Bundled Radio Transmitter | Frequency %1$s (%2$s) | Sending %3$s | Reach %4$s blocks
message.reikos_signal_tower.anchor_none: No Radio Mast 2 to 12 blocks from this Guy Wire Anchor to brace
message.reikos_signal_tower.anchor_brace: Bracing the mast at %1$s, %2$s, %3$s (%4$s tall): %5$s of %6$s guy wires, it stands in any storm
message.reikos_signal_tower.anchor_more: Bracing the mast at %1$s, %2$s, %3$s (%4$s tall): %5$s of %6$s guy wires
message.reikos_signal_tower.storm_damage: Storm damage: %1$s blew down your %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, %5$s. Right-click it with an Iron Ingot to repair it
jade.reikos_signal_tower.anchor_none: No mast to brace (2 to 12 blocks out)
jade.reikos_signal_tower.storm_damaged: Blown down by %s: right-click it with an Iron Ingot to repair
jade.reikos_signal_tower.iced: Iced up: reach -%1$s%% until it thaws (%2$s of %3$s s above freezing)
jade.reikos_signal_tower.not_braced: Not braced: %1$s of %2$s guy wires (storms can blow it down)
jade.reikos_signal_tower.braces_short: Guy wires: %s (too short to blow down)
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_weather_: A transmitter that broadcasts the conditions where it stands: the weather, the time of day or the moon (more with Reiko's Weather). A redstone signal into it pauses it. Right-click it with an empty hand to pick what it reads.
message.reikos_signal_tower.station_stat: Weather Station | Frequency %1$s | %2$s: %3$s | Sending %4$s | Reach %5$s blocks
station.reikos_signal_tower.scale.time: 06:00 is 0, then 1 more every 1.5 hours: noon 4, 18:00 8, midnight 12
station.reikos_signal_tower.scale.moon: full moon 1 ... new moon 5 ... 8; a Blood Moon 15
station.reikos_signal_tower.scale.condit: Reiko's Weather's code: clear 0, rain 4, thunderstorm 6, snow 11, heatwave 15...
station.reikos_signal_tower.scale.storm: thunder or severe 15, hail or heavy rain 10, rain 5, else 0
station.reikos_signal_tower.scale.storm_: overhead 15, then 1 less every 100 blocks to its edge
screen.reikos_signal_tower.station.annou: Sends a message on its frequency when the weather where it stands changes ("Now: Rain"): pagers, Radio Telegraphs and Status Boards in its reach show it.
Rain and thunder where it stands, as towers' reach goes by. Shift-click or scroll to go back.
The time of day, in 16 steps: 8 or more is night (18:00 to 06:00).
Tonight's moon, from full (1) to waxing gibbous (8).
Reiko's Weather's weather code, the same as its own Weather Station's.
How dangerous the weather is, the same as Reiko's Weather Station's.
How strong the wind is where it stands (higher up is windier).
How hard it rains or snows where it stands.
The air temperature where it stands (season, height, time of day and weather count).
The season, from Reiko's Weather (or Serene Seasons through it).
How close the nearest storm is, like Reiko's Weather Radar: bases can get ready before it arrives.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.station.pause: Paused: a redstone signal reaches it
screen.reikos_signal_tower.station.down: Not sending: knocked out or out of power
screen.reikos_signal_tower.station.more_: Install Reiko's Weather for 7 more readings
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.mast_builder: Right-click a tower's mast or top with this to add a mast under the top. Sneak to place it normally.
message.reikos_signal_tower.mast_added: Mast added: the %1$s is %2$s masts up, reach %3$s → %4$s blocks
message.reikos_signal_tower.mast_grown: Mast added on top: %s masts tall
message.reikos_signal_tower.mast_no_room: No room to raise it: %1$s is in the way at %2$s
message.reikos_signal_tower.mast_too_hig: It can't go any higher: that's the top of the world
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_telegrap: Type short messages onto a frequency. Pagers, other telegraphs and Status Boards on it in reach read them.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.telegraph_us: Right-click to open it. When a message arrives it clicks and gives a 1-second redstone pulse.
message.reikos_signal_tower.telegraph_st: Radio Telegraph | Frequency %1$s | %2$s messages here | Reach %3$s
message.reikos_signal_tower.telegraph_re: No pager or telegraph in range
message.reikos_signal_tower.pager_catchu: %1$s: while you were away, a message on %2$s from %3$s (Day %4$s, %5$s): “%6$s”
%1$s: while you were away, %3$s messages on %2$s; the last from %4$s (Day %5$s, %6$s): “%7$s”
message.reikos_signal_tower.intruder_tel: %1$s tried to send a telegraph message on %3$s, but it's private: refused
screen.reikos_signal_tower.telegraph.emp: No messages have reached it yet
screen.reikos_signal_tower.telegraph.dea: Encrypted by %s: this telegraph can't read it
jade.reikos_signal_tower.telegraph_none: No messages have reached it yet
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_transmit: Broadcasts the redstone signal it receives. The higher it sits, the farther it reaches. Also relays nearby Remote Control presses.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_receiver: Outputs the strongest signal on its frequency.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_toggle_r: Flips on or off each time its frequency turns on, like a light switch. Outputs full strength while on.
jade.reikos_signal_tower.lifted: Up high: hears lower towers up to %s blocks away
reikos_signal_tower.configuration.receiv: Receiver height reach (% of a transmitter's there; 0 = off)
reikos_signal_tower.configuration.lightn: Lightning strikes per hour on a tower 64 high (0 = never)
Seconds a struck tower stays quiet
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_jammer.t: A tower top that drowns out its frequency around it while redstone reaches it (or a mast under it): everything there hears that much less, and full strength (15) silences it. It reaches half as far as a transmitter at the same height; masts and antennas help.
message.reikos_signal_tower.private_refu: Can't do that: it would jam %s, which is private to %s
message.reikos_signal_tower.private_sile: Silent: %s is private to %s, so this won't jam
reikos_signal_tower.configuration.rainRe: Reach lost in rain or snow (%)
reikos_signal_tower.configuration.terrai: Blocks of ground per 1 strength lost (0 = off)
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.antenna_item: Fit it to a transmitter, repeater or converter for %s its reach.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.antenna_hint: Right-click a tower top with it; sneak + right-click the tower with an empty hand to take it off.
jade.reikos_signal_tower.faded: Faded: -%s (far out in its tower's reach)
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.ender_item: Fit it to a Radio Transmitter (plain, timer, recorder or weather station) and it also sends into another dimension, from the same spot there: into the Nether from the Overworld (at 1/8 of the coordinates) and into the Overworld from anywhere else. Use another on it to pick the next dimension. Its reach stays as with no antenna.
message.reikos_signal_tower.ender_fitted: %s: Ender Antenna fitted: sending into %s too (arriving at %s)
message.reikos_signal_tower.ender_relink: %s: Ender Antenna now sends into %s (arriving at %s)
message.reikos_signal_tower.ender_nowher: %s: Ender Antenna fitted, but there's no other dimension to send into
message.reikos_signal_tower.ender_transm: Only a Radio Transmitter (plain, timer, recorder or weather station) can send into another dimension
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.solar_help: Put it on a Radio Battery: it charges it by daylight, up to %s a second at noon in clear weather (less in rain and early or late in the day, none at night or under a roof).
jade.reikos_signal_tower.solar_charging: Charging the battery under it: %s a second
jade.reikos_signal_tower.solar_dark: Not charging: too dark (night, or something over it)
jade.reikos_signal_tower.battery_use_cov: Powering towers: %s a second (the Solar Panel keeps up)
reikos_signal_tower.configuration.solarC: Solar Panel charge a second in full sun
jade.reikos_signal_tower.unpowered: Out of power: needs a charged Radio Battery next to it or its mast
jade.reikos_signal_tower.tower_battery_i: Battery: %s%% (uses %s a second while it sends)
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.battery_help: Powers a tower next to it (or next to its mast) while the tower sends. Right-click it with Redstone Dust or Blocks of Redstone to charge it; hoppers, pipes and FE cables work too.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.coverage_leg: Green: strong, yellow: fair, orange and red: weak, blank: not heard
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.coverage_hel: Right-click: draw it where you stand. Sneak + right-click: zoom out. Sneak + right-click a radio block: map its frequency.
reikos_signal_tower.configuration.charge: Charge a second per 64 blocks of reach
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.dish_item: Fit it to a transmitter, repeater, converter or jammer for %s its reach in the direction you face as you fit it (a narrow beam); elsewhere it reaches as far as with no antenna.
message.reikos_signal_tower.dish_fitted: %s: Dish Antenna aimed %s: %s blocks that way, %s elsewhere
message.reikos_signal_tower.dish_reaimed: %s: Dish Antenna turned to face %s (%s blocks that way)
reikos_signal_tower.configuration.signal: Signal fade starts at (% of the reach)
Signal fade at the edge of reach
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_lamp.too: A lamp with a receiver built in: it gives off as much light as the strength it hears (dim to bright), in its dye color. Right-click it with a dye to change the color. It's only a light: no redstone comes out.
block.reikos_signal_tower.aviation_beaco: A warning light for the top or side of a tower (or any block). It blinks red at night, can be seen from far away, and can blink only while its tower is broadcasting. All beacons blink together. Right-click it with an empty hand to set it.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.beacon.when_n: At night, and in rain and storms (always in the Nether and the End): from dusk to dawn, the hours you can sleep.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.beacon.when_s: Only while the tower it's on (the transmitter, repeater or converter it's on, or on top of its mast) is broadcasting, so you can see from afar whether the tower is on.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.beacon.patter: One second on, one second off.
A short flash every second and a half, like a strobe.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.beacon.no_tow: Not on a tower: it will stay dark
screen.reikos_signal_tower.beacon.tower_: On a %s (%s blocks up): not sending
jade.reikos_signal_tower.beacon_no_tower: Not on a tower: stays dark
jade.reikos_signal_tower.beacon_tower_si: Tower: %s on %s, %s blocks up, not sending
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_signal_r: A transmitter that records up to 30 seconds of a frequency (every on, off and strength) and plays it back on its own frequency: once on each redstone pulse, or on a loop while powered. Right-click it with an empty hand to record.
message.reikos_signal_tower.recorder_sta: Signal Recorder | Frequency %s | %s | Sending %s | Reach %s blocks
message.reikos_signal_tower.recorder_sam: It can't record %s and play on it too: pick two different frequencies
message.reikos_signal_tower.recorder_wai: Radio Signal Recorder: waiting for %s to turn on...
message.reikos_signal_tower.recorder_no_: Set a frequency to record from first
message.reikos_signal_tower.recorder_sto: Radio Signal Recorder: stopped waiting (the old recording is kept)
message.reikos_signal_tower.recorder_set: Radio Signal Recorder: plays on %s, records from %s, plays %s
screen.reikos_signal_tower.recorder.list: The frequency it records, as heard where it stands. Record waits for it to turn on, then records every change until Stop (30 seconds at most).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.recorder.send: The frequency it plays the recording on (it sends it like a transmitter, reaching as far as its height).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.recorder.once: Plays the recording from the start each time a redstone signal reaches it (or a mast under it).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.recorder.loop: Plays the recording over and over while a redstone signal reaches it (or a mast under it), and stops when it goes.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.recorder.reco: Saves the boxes, then waits for Records from to turn on and records until Stop. The old recording stays until the new one starts.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.recorder.empt: Nothing recorded yet: press Record, then send on Records from
jade.reikos_signal_tower.recorder_waitin: Waiting for a signal to record
A receiver that also plays a sound when its frequency turns on: a bell, chime, doorbell and more, once or every second while it's on. Right-click it with an empty hand to pick the sound. It plays a Radio Jukebox's song instead.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_status_b: A panel for a wall that shows up to four frequencies: each one's name, a light and the strength heard there, readable in the dark. Right-click it with an empty hand to pick them.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.satellite_he: Put it on a Launch Pad with %s Firework Rockets and give the pad a redstone pulse: it goes up to orbit over the dimension. With a satellite up, towers there with a Satellite Dish are heard everywhere in that dimension.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.satellite_di: Fit it to a Radio Transmitter (plain, timer, recorder, weather station, jukebox or bundled) with open sky above: once a satellite is in orbit over its dimension, the tower is heard everywhere in that dimension, at full strength, over any hills. It uses %2$s times the power while it's uplinked.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.antenna_sate: Antenna: %s (heard across the dimension through a satellite)
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.launch_pad_h: Load a Satellite and %s Firework Rockets (by hand or with hoppers), then give it a redstone pulse to send the satellite up to orbit. It needs open sky above, in a dimension with a sky (not the Nether or the End). An empty hand takes back what's on it; a comparator reads 15 when it's ready.
message.reikos_signal_tower.satellite_tr: Only a Radio Transmitter (plain, timer, recorder, weather station, jukebox or bundled) can take a Satellite Dish
message.reikos_signal_tower.satellite_no: %s has a Satellite Dish, but it needs open sky above to reach a satellite
%s has a Satellite Dish: once a satellite is in orbit over %s, it'll be heard everywhere there
message.reikos_signal_tower.satellite_fi: %s is uplinked: heard everywhere in %s through the satellite
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_no_sa: The Launch Pad has no satellite on it
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_firew: The Launch Pad needs %2$s Firework Rockets (it has %1$s)
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_no_sp: No orbit over %s: satellites need a sky
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_no_sk: The Launch Pad needs open sky above it
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_has_s: There's a satellite on the Launch Pad already
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_firew: The Launch Pad has all the rockets it needs
Those rockets don't match the ones on the pad
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_unloa: You took everything off the Launch Pad
message.reikos_signal_tower.launch_ready: Ready for launch: give the Launch Pad a redstone pulse
jade.reikos_signal_tower.uplink_no_sky: Antenna: %s (needs open sky to reach a satellite)
advancements.reikos_signal_tower.we_have: Put a satellite in orbit from a Launch Pad
A transmitter with a record player. Put a music disc in and it broadcasts the song on its frequency: Radio Speakers that hear it play the song. A redstone pulse plays it again; steady redstone repeats it. Empty hand takes the disc out.
jade.reikos_signal_tower.board_empty: No frequencies yet: right-click it to pick up to four
screen.reikos_signal_tower.speaker.sound: What it plays. Shift-click or scroll to go back.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.speaker.pitch: The note, like a note block's (F♯4 is the sound's own pitch). Shift-click or scroll to go back.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.speaker.volum: Quiet and normal are heard within 16 blocks, loud within 48.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.speaker.repea: Once each time its frequency turns on, or every second for as long as it stays on (an alarm).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.speaker.test_: Plays the sound for you only
screen.reikos_signal_tower.board.explain: Shows up to four frequencies, as heard here
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_timer_tr: A transmitter with a clock: it sends full strength every few seconds or minutes, or between two times of day. A redstone signal into it pauses it. Right-click it with an empty hand to set its schedule.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_counter_: Counts how many times its frequency turns on, and turns on at a set number: for a 1-second pulse, or until its reset frequency turns on. Right-click it with an empty hand to set it up.
message.reikos_signal_tower.timer_status: Timer Transmitter | Frequency %s | %s | Sending %s | Reach %s blocks
message.reikos_signal_tower.counter_text: on at %s turn-ons, then a 1s pulse
message.reikos_signal_tower.counter_clea: Radio Counter Receiver: count back to 0
jade.reikos_signal_tower.timer_paused: Paused: a redstone signal reaches it
jade.reikos_signal_tower.counter_reset_d: Can't hear its reset frequency: encrypted by %s
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.mode_in: Sends a pulse again and again, a set time apart.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.mode_da: On between two in-game times every day (18:00 to 06:00 is every night).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.interva: How long from one pulse to the next. Shift-click or scroll to go back.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.pulse_t: How long each pulse lasts (at most half the time between pulses).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.on_hour: The in-game time it turns on. Shift-click or scroll to go back.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.off_hou: The in-game time it turns off. Shift-click or scroll to go back.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.paused: Paused: a redstone signal reaches it
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.never: On and off at the same time: never on
screen.reikos_signal_tower.timer.hint: A redstone signal into it (or its masts) pauses it
screen.reikos_signal_tower.counter.targe: How many turn-ons of its frequency it counts before it turns on. Shift-click or scroll to go back.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.counter.latch: Outputs 15 for a second, then counts from 0 again.
Outputs 15 until its reset frequency turns on (or Reset count is pressed).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.counter.forge: Starts the count over after this long without a turn-on, for a quick knock. None: never.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.counter.reset: A turn-on of this frequency sets the count back to 0 and switches it off. Leave it empty for none.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.counter.clear: Saves, and sets the count back to 0
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_delay_re: A receiver with a timer: it turns on and off its delay after its frequency does, and stays on for its hold after it turns off. Right-click it to set them.
message.reikos_signal_tower.delay_status: Delay Receiver | Frequency %s | Delay %s, hold %s | Hearing %s | %s
screen.reikos_signal_tower.delay.delay_t: It turns on and off this long after its frequency does, like a long redstone repeater. Shift-click or scroll to go back.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.delay.hold_ti: It stays on this long after that turns off, so a short pulse keeps it on for a while.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.delay.deaf: Deaf: %s is encrypted by %s, so it hears nothing
message.reikos_signal_tower.converter_se: Radio Converter: listens on %s, sends on %s, %s
screen.reikos_signal_tower.converter.gat: Pass: sends what it hears, at the same strength. Click for At least (Shift-click goes back).
At least: sends what it hears only when it's at least the level on the right, like a comparator. Click for Below.
Below: sends 15 while what it hears is below the level on the right. At 1, while it hears nothing: a NOT gate. Click for Pass.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.converter.thr: The gate's level, 1 to 15. Click for more, Shift-click for less.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_logic_re: Listens on two frequencies and outputs when both are on (AND), either is on (OR) or exactly one is on (XOR). Right-click it to set them.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.logic.explain: Outputs when its two frequencies match the mode
screen.reikos_signal_tower.logic.directo: Pick the first frequency from the frequency directory
Pick the second frequency from the frequency directory
screen.reikos_signal_tower.logic.mode_an: AND: on while both frequencies are on, at the weaker strength. Click for OR (Shift-click goes back).
screen.reikos_signal_tower.logic.mode_or: OR: on while either frequency is on, at the stronger strength. Click for XOR.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.logic.mode_xo: XOR: on while exactly one of them is on, at its strength. Click for AND.
screen.reikos_signal_tower.logic.deaf: Deaf: %s is encrypted by %s, so it hears nothing there
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.meter_help: Hold it to see the strength where you stand. Right-click: tick on/off. Sneak + right-click: frequency
screen.reikos_signal_tower.tuner.meter_s: Ticks like a Geiger counter while you hold it: faster and higher the stronger the signal
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_inverted: Outputs full strength while its frequency is silent, and nothing while it's on.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_repeater: Picks up its frequency and broadcasts it again from its own height, to chain towers across long distances. Needs no redstone.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_converte: Picks up one frequency and broadcasts it on another, from its own height. Needs no redstone.
tooltip.reikos_signal_tower.converter_hi: Right-click it with an empty hand to set both frequencies and its gate. The tuner sets the one it listens on
screen.reikos_signal_tower.converter.qui: Nothing to convert: %s is quiet here
message.reikos_signal_tower.converter_se: Radio Converter: listens on %s, sends on %s
message.reikos_signal_tower.converter_st: Converter | Listens on %s | Sends on %s | %s | Reach %s blocks
block.reikos_signal_tower.compact_radio_: A button-sized receiver. Sticks to walls, floors and ceilings, and powers the block it's on.
block.reikos_signal_tower.radio_mast.too: Tower segment. Carries a redstone signal up to the transmitter on top.

info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_transmitt: Sends the redstone signal it gets (0-15) on its frequency. Stand it on Radio Masts: it reaches 32 blocks, plus 8 for every block its top is above sea level. Give it redstone beside the top or beside any mast under it. With power cost on (the default) it also needs a charged Radio Battery beside the top or a mast. Tune it with a Frequency Tuner.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_receiver: Gives out the strongest signal it hears on its frequency, from any transmitter whose reach covers it (higher up, it hears farther). Tune it with a Frequency Tuner.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_toggle_re: Turns on, or off again, each time its frequency turns on: a wireless T flip-flop.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_inverted_: Gives out 15 while its frequency is silent, and 0 while it hears it.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_logic_rec: Listens on two frequencies and puts them together: AND (both on), OR (either) or XOR (just one). Right-click it to set them.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_delay_rec: A receiver that holds every change back, by up to 60 seconds, and can keep its output on for a while after.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_speaker: A receiver that plays a sound (a bell, a chime, a doorbell and more) each time its frequency turns on. When a Radio Jukebox broadcasts on its frequency, it plays the song instead.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_status_bo: A panel for walls that shows up to four frequencies: their names, strengths and the last telegraph message.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_counter_r: Counts the times its frequency turns on; at the number you set it gives a pulse, or stays on until its reset frequency turns on.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_timer_tra: Sends 15 on a timer: a short pulse every so often, or every day between two hours. Redstone pauses it.
info.reikos_signal_tower.guy_anchor: Put three on the ground 2 to 12 blocks from the foot of a tall tower (4 masts or more) to brace it with guy wires: then storms (with Reiko's Weather) can't blow it down.
info.reikos_signal_tower.tower_platform: Right-click a mast with Tower Platforms to put 8 round it, with rails on the outside. You can stand on them; sneak by the mast to drop through.
info.reikos_signal_tower.bundled_cable: Carries 16 colored channels at once, with no loss. Cable Taps put signals on and take them off; the Bundled Radio Transmitter and Receiver send all 16 by radio.
info.reikos_signal_tower.cable_tap: Puts a redstone signal onto its color's channel of the Bundled Cable it faces, or gives that channel out. Right-click with an empty hand to switch between in and out, with a dye to change its color.
info.reikos_signal_tower.bundled_transmi: A tower top that sends the 16 channels of the Bundled Cable touching it: color c on its frequency + c.
info.reikos_signal_tower.bundled_receive: Listens on its frequency and the 15 after it, and puts what it hears onto the Bundled Cable touching it, one channel each.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_weather_s: A transmitter that sends a reading where it stands instead of redstone: the weather, the time of day or the moon (and more with Reiko's Weather). It can also tell pagers when the weather changes.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_signal_re: Records up to 30 seconds of a frequency, then plays it back on its own frequency: once for each redstone pulse, or over and over while powered.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_jukebox: A tower top with a record player. Put a music disc in and it broadcasts the song on its frequency, sending 15 while it plays: Radio Speakers that hear the frequency within its reach play the song where they stand (16, 32 or 64 blocks round, by their volume). A redstone pulse plays it again, steady redstone repeats it, and an empty hand takes the disc out. Hoppers can put discs in, and take them out when a song ends.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_jammer: Stand it on masts like a transmitter: anything in its reach hears its frequency weaker by the redstone strength it gets (15 silences it).
info.reikos_signal_tower.aviation_beacon: A red or white warning light for the top or side of a tower: on at night, always, or while its tower sends; blinking, flashing or steady. Right-click it to set it.
info.reikos_signal_tower.solar_panel: Put it on top of a Radio Battery to charge the battery in daylight.
info.reikos_signal_tower.dish_rotator: A mast that turns the Dish Antenna on top of its tower by redstone: each strength turns it a sixteenth of the way round.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_telegraph: Type a short message (up to 64 characters) onto a frequency: pagers, other telegraphs and Status Boards in reach get it. A villager with no job takes it as a workstation and becomes a Radio Operator.
info.reikos_signal_tower.satellite: Put it on a Launch Pad with 8 Firework Rockets and give the pad a redstone pulse: it goes up to orbit over the dimension, and you can see it cross the night sky. With a satellite up, towers there with a Satellite Dish are heard everywhere in that dimension.
info.reikos_signal_tower.satellite_dish: Fit it on a transmitter's tower with open sky above: once a satellite is in orbit over the dimension, the tower is heard everywhere in it, at full strength and over any hills. It uses 4 times the power while it's uplinked.
info.reikos_signal_tower.launch_pad: Load a Satellite and 8 Firework Rockets, by hand or with hoppers, then give it a redstone pulse: the rocket climbs to orbit. It needs open sky above, in a dimension with a sky (not the Nether or the End). A comparator reads 15 when it's ready.
info.reikos_signal_tower.ender_antenna: Fit it on a transmitter's tower: the tower also sends into another dimension, from the matching place (the Nether from the Overworld, or the Overworld from the others). It doubles the power the tower uses.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_battery: Powers a tower when power cost is on: put it beside the tower's top or one of its masts. Charge it with redstone (dust or blocks), with Forge Energy, or with a Solar Panel on top.
info.reikos_signal_tower.coverage_map: A map tuned to a frequency: it shows where that frequency can be heard, from strong to weak, with its towers marked.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_lamp: A receiver whose light shows how strong a signal it hears. Comes in all 16 dye colors.
info.reikos_signal_tower.iron_antenna: Right-click the top of a full-size tower (a transmitter, repeater, converter or jammer) with it to fit it: reach x1.5. Fitting another gives this one back; sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it off.
info.reikos_signal_tower.gold_antenna: Right-click the top of a full-size tower (a transmitter, repeater, converter or jammer) with it to fit it: reach x2. Fitting another gives this one back; sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it off.
info.reikos_signal_tower.diamond_antenna: Right-click the top of a full-size tower (a transmitter, repeater, converter or jammer) with it to fit it: reach x3. Fitting another gives this one back; sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it off.
info.reikos_signal_tower.netherite_anten: Right-click the top of a full-size tower (a transmitter, repeater, converter or jammer) with it to fit it: reach x4. Fitting another gives this one back; sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it off.
info.reikos_signal_tower.dish_antenna: Fit it on a tower top and it faces the way you look: reach x3 in a narrow beam that way (15 degrees either side), and plain reach everywhere else.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_repeater: Stand it on masts: it hears its frequency where it stands and sends it again with its own reach, to carry a signal farther.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_converter: A repeater that listens on one frequency and sends on another. Its gate can make it a wireless comparator or NOT gate. Right-click it to set it.
info.reikos_signal_tower.compact_radio_r: A receiver the size of a button, for walls, floors and ceilings. It strongly powers the block it's on.
info.reikos_signal_tower.compact_radio_t: A transmitter the size of a button: it sends the signal around it over a fixed 16 blocks, at any height, with no masts or battery.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_motion_se: An eye the size of a button: it sends 15 over 16 blocks while it sees a player in range.
info.reikos_signal_tower.code_keypad: The right code pulses its frequency and powers the block it's on; three wrong codes lock it for 30 seconds and tell its owner. Its owner sets the code, and can hand out guest codes.
info.reikos_signal_tower.radio_mast: A lattice section for towers: stack masts under a transmitter (or repeater or jammer) to raise it, and redstone beside any of them reaches the top. Right-click a tower with a mast to add one under the top. Walk into a mast to climb it.
info.reikos_signal_tower.wall_redstone: Redstone dust for the sides of blocks and for ceilings: it runs up, down and sideways, and powers the block it's on.
info.reikos_signal_tower.frequency_tuner: Right-click the air to choose a frequency (1 to 999,999,999), name it or make it private. Right-click a radio block to tune it; sneak and right-click to copy its frequency. Sneak and scroll to step the frequency.
info.reikos_signal_tower.remote_control: A transmitter in your hand: right-click to send a pulse or a toggle on its frequency, as far as a transmitter at your height would reach (towers in reach pass it on). Sneak and right-click the air to set it.
info.reikos_signal_tower.multi_remote: A remote with 4 buttons, each with its own name, color, frequency and mode. Sneak and scroll to pick a button; sneak and right-click the air to set them.
info.reikos_signal_tower.pager: Keep it anywhere in your inventory: it beeps and tells you when its frequency turns on where you are, and shows telegraph messages. Sneak and right-click the air to set its frequency.
info.reikos_signal_tower.signal_meter: Hold it to see how strong its frequency is where you stand, how many towers reach you, and how far it is to the edge.
info.reikos_signal_tower.signal_scanner: Lists everything a receiver where you stand would hear: each frequency, its strength, and the strongest sender with its distance and direction. Click a tower in the list for an arrow to it.
